purpose: Assist procurement officers in searching marine spare parts, comparing supplier pricing, checking availability, and following maritime procurement guidelines.
target_audience: Vessel procurement staff and technical superintendents
scope: Spare parts catalog lookup, supplier price comparison, purchase approval thresholds, and delivery lead times.

document_inventory.description: Contains approx 1479 characters. Sample: PACIFIC HORIZON MARITIME - VESSEL PROCUREMENT GUIDELINES DOCUMENT REF: POL-PROC-2024 | FLEET COMPLIA...
Contains approx 2003 characters. Sample: [Row 1] part_number: NV-PUMP-001, description: Main Engine Fuel Oil Delivery Pump, equipment_system:...
Contains approx 1494 characters. Sample: PACIFIC HORIZON MARITIME - APPROVED SUPPLIER DIRECTORY DOCUMENT REF: DIR-SUPP-2024 | FLEET TECHNICAL...

assumptions: Prices listed in CSV are in USD and exclude freight unless specified.
ambiguities: Whether expedited freight quotes require superintendent sign-off.

clarifications.question: Are emergency orders subject to standard threshold limits?
clarifications.answer: Emergency orders allow up to $10,000 superintendent approval.
